answer_rationale: The document discusses language identification (LID) for South African languages, some of which are similar and challenging to distinguish. It mentions the use of a lexicon-based classifier and highlights that the performance of the algorithm depends on the support of the lexicon, implying that lexicons are tailored to specific language groups or contexts. This suggests that lexicons are not universal across all languages.
